fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

global_signals.name: ACLK
global_signals.semantics: Global clock signal; rising edge times all transfers.

global_signals.name: ARESETn
global_signals.semantics: Global active-LOW reset; async assert, sync deassert.

signals_ace_added.name: AWDOMAIN
signals_ace_added.semantics: Shareability domain: Non-shareable / Inner / Outer / System (Table C3-2).

signals_ace_added.name: AWUNIQUE
signals_ace_added.semantics: Optional — present when WriteEvict (AWSNOOP=0b101) is supported.

signals_ace_added.name: BRESP
signals_ace_added.semantics: Extended from AXI [1:0] to [2:0]; bit [2] = DataTransfer (for WriteUnique/WriteLineUnique pass-dirty).

signals_ace_added.name: ARSNOOP
signals_ace_added.semantics: Coherent read / cache-maintenance / DVM transaction type (Table C3-7).

signals_ace_added.name: RRESP
signals_ace_added.semantics: Extended from AXI [1:0] to [3:0]; bit [2]=PassDirty, bit [3]=IsShared.

signals.name: ACREADY
signals.semantics: Master ready to accept snoop address.

signals.name: ACSNOOP
signals.semantics: Snoop transaction type (same coding as ARSNOOP coherent reads).

signals.name: CRREADY
signals.semantics: Interconnect ready to accept snoop response.

signals.name: CRRESP
signals.semantics: Snoop response: [0] DataTransfer, [1] Error, [2] PassDirty, [3] IsShared, [4] WasUnique.

signals.name: CDREADY
signals.semantics: Interconnect ready to accept snoop data beat.

signals.name: CDDATA
signals.semantics: Snoop data payload; 32/64/128/256/512/1024 bits; may differ from RDATA/WDATA width.

signals.name: CDLAST
signals.semantics: Asserted on the final beat of a snoop data burst.

ace_acknowledge_signals.name: RACK
ace_acknowledge_signals.semantics: Single-cycle pulse one ACLK after RLAST+RVALID+RREADY rising-edge; confirms read response accepted.

ace_acknowledge_signals.name: WACK
ace_acknowledge_signals.semantics: Single-cycle pulse one ACLK after BVALID+BREADY rising-edge; confirms write response accepted.

dependency_graph_ace_snoops.rule_1: Interconnect drives ACVALID independent of ACREADY.
dependency_graph_ace_snoops.rule_2: Master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY before asserting CRVALID.
dependency_graph_ace_snoops.rule_3: Master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY before asserting CDVALID (if DataTransfer=1).
dependency_graph_ace_snoops.rule_4: CRVALID and CDVALID must not depend combinationally on CRREADY/CDREADY.
dependency_graph_ace_snoops.rule_5: Interconnect may wait for CRVALID or CDVALID (or both, if DataTransfer=1) before completing the snoop on the originating AX channel.

ordering_rules_ace.snoop_ordering: All snoop transactions are ordered: CR responses follow AC address order per master.
ordering_rules_ace.RACK_required_before: Interconnect must observe RACK before issuing further snoops dependent on the read transaction's coherency state.
ordering_rules_ace.WACK_required_before: Interconnect must observe WACK before issuing further snoops dependent on the write transaction's coherency state.
ordering_rules_ace.same_id_ordering: Inherited from AXI: same AxID -> in-order completion.
ordering_rules_ace.different_id_ordering: Inherited from AXI: no ordering constraint.

evidence.quote: The ACE protocol introduces additional signals on the read/write address channels (AxDOMAIN, AxSNOOP, AxBAR), extensions to RRESP and BRESP, and three new snoop channels: AC, CR, CD.
All snoop transactions are ordered. A response on the snoop response channel must be in the same order as the addresses on the snoop address channel.
The width of the snoop data bus, CDDATA, is not required to be the same width as the read data and write data buses.

evidence.spec_section: C3.9 Snoop channel dependencies / Figure C3-1
evidence.quote: Snoop channel dependency diagram showing ACVALID/ACREADY/CRVALID/CDVALID relationships.
RACK is asserted one ACLK cycle after the read response transaction completes; WACK is asserted one ACLK cycle after the write response transaction completes.
